newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT - Australia 10-yr bond chasing the trendline.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Australia 10-yr bond chasing the trendline.

text.p: *The Australian September 10-year bond futures contract ended the after hours session teetering on this month's steep rising trendline at 92.950.
*U.S. Treasuries ended little changed after a late burst of short covering helped the market recoup its early losses.

The September Australian 10-year bond futures contract looks set for another session of chasing this month's steep rising trendline if it is maintain the overall rally and have a crack at this week's 93.090 peak.

The contract ended the after hours session teetering on the trendline at 92.950, just below a SYCOM high of 92.955 and compared with Thursday's 92.935 pit close. Analysts said the market is in slightly more positive shape after the much needed pullback to 92.845 in the previous after hours session, and winding back from an extremely overbought position.
A late burst of short covering in U.S. Treasuries helped the market recover its early losses and underpined domestic bond futures contracts.
However, the risk for both markets now is a lack of fresh data until next week, which is expected to keep turnovers limited and could see prices drift lower, analysts said.

A thin local statistics calender has reduced trading interest dramatically in the last couple of days, although hopes of a monetary policy easing after the Reserve Bank board meeting on July 1 is expected to limit any sustained downward move.
